description: Discipline presets have ONE loader and resolver, bin/lib/disciplines.ts, over templates/presets/disciplines.json (the PRD §8 table): it alone maps a discipline to its citation style, source preference, sectioning convention, counterargument default, per-paragraph citation density and tone, and it alone normalises free text to a preset slug. No other shipped module holds a discipline-slug string literal ('history', 'computer-science', …): a private map is how citations.ts, citation-density.ts and intake-parse.ts drifted from PRD §8 and from each other. Call presetFor / resolveDiscipline / defaultCitationStyleFor / densityBandFor / normalizeDisciplineSlug instead; data that names disciplines (aliases, stub prose) lives in JSON.
